content: Cordarone® (amiodarone HCl) tablets are provided in bottles containing 60 tablets. Each tablet contains 200 mg of the active ingredient. The tablets are round, convex in shape, and pink in color. They have a raised C and are marked with 200 on one side. The reverse side of the tablet is scored and marked with WYETH and 4188. The tablets should be stored in a tightly closed container. They must be kept at a controlled room temperature, specifically between 20°C and 25°C (68°F to 77°F).
